tasks.title: Diagnose, repair and verify the suite
tasks.description: The end-to-end suite fails: the HermeticByExpectedOutputCount guard reports 0 outputs (the transaction never executed). The fault is a single trap (s13#3) in Runner/test.qaas.yaml: the Http transaction 'Trans1' has no DataSourceNames, so it is never driven by any data row and produces zero outputs. Reproduce the failure, apply the MINIMAL fix to Runner/test.qaas.yaml (add 'DataSourceNames: [DummyDS]' to the Trans1 transaction - change nothing else; do NOT rewrite the file, rename anything, or touch the mocker), write DIAGNOSIS.md citing s13#3 explicitly, and run the e2e verify gate.
rubric: Diagnosis is complete and references the exact trap

verify.cmd: $m = Start-Process dotnet -ArgumentList 'run','-c','Release','--','run','test.mocker.yaml' -WorkingDirectory '..\Mocker' -PassThru; $ok = $false; foreach ($i in 1..40) { try { (New-Object Net.Sockets.TcpClient('127.0.0.1', 8119)).Close(); $ok = $true; break } catch { Start-Sleep 2 } }; if (-not $ok) { Stop-Process -Id $m.Id -Force; exit 9 }; dotnet run -c Release -- run test.qaas.yaml; $code = $LASTEXITCODE; Stop-Process -Id $m.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit $code

acceptanceCriteria: E2E runs successfully green (guard sees exactly 1 output)
failureModes: Removing the guard instead of adding DataSourceNames

goalOneSentence: Diagnose and fix missing-DataSourceNames caused by trap s13#3.
portContract: This sprint's mocker MUST listen on HTTP port 8119. Every runner Transaction MUST target http://127.0.0.1:8119. Do NOT use the 8080 default from Fact Base examples - use 8119 exactly.
